assemblySteps.title: Prepare supporting infrastructure
assemblySteps.instructions: Confirm the raised bed, power, water, and internet requirements before installing the FarmBot frame.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Bed, power, water, and network constraints are ready for machine installation.

assemblySteps.title: Install tracks
assemblySteps.instructions: Assemble and mount the track extrusions so the gantry can travel across the growing bed.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Tracks are parallel, square, and securely fastened.

assemblySteps.title: Build the gantry
assemblySteps.instructions: Assemble gantry columns, the gantry main beam, drivetrain hardware, belts, pulleys, and wheel plates.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Gantry moves smoothly along the tracks without binding.

assemblySteps.title: Assemble cross-slide and z-axis
assemblySteps.instructions: Install the cross-slide, z-axis extrusion, motor housing, lead motion, and cable carrier supports.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Cross-slide and z-axis travel smoothly through their expected ranges.

assemblySteps.title: Install toolbays and tools
assemblySteps.instructions: Install toolbays and prepare interchangeable tools including watering, seeding, soil sensing, and rotary tooling.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Tools dock, undock, and align with the universal tool mount.

assemblySteps.title: Wire electronics
assemblySteps.instructions: Mount and wire the Farmduino, Raspberry Pi, motors, encoders, camera, UTM cables, solenoid valve, and power supply.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: Continuity, polarity, motor, encoder, peripheral, and emergency-stop checks pass.

assemblySteps.title: Complete calibration and final checks
assemblySteps.instructions: Run final setup, calibrate movement, verify tool operation, and document the rebuild package.
assemblySteps.qualityCheck: FarmBot moves, senses, and operates tools under reviewed configuration.

sourceParts.name: Bearing

sourceParts.name: Belt Clip Dampener

sourceParts.name: Belt Sleeve

sourceParts.name: Belt
sourceParts.description: Tech specs for the belts in FarmBot Genesis. Visit [our shop](http://shop.farm.bot) to purchase parts.

sourceParts.name: Leadscrew Block
sourceParts.description: This delrin block attaches to the cross-slide plate so that the leadscrew can move through it, allowing FarmBot to move in the Z direction.

sourceParts.name: Leadscrew
sourceParts.description: This stainless steel leadscrew allows FarmBot to move in the Z direction.

sourceParts.name: M5 Precision Shim
sourceParts.description: This shim is placed in between the two bearings in every pre-assembled V-wheel.

sourceParts.name: Pulley
sourceParts.description: These pulleys are attached directly to NEMA 17 stepper motor shafts or onto the driveshaft. They transfer power from the motor to the belt such that FarmBot can move in the X and Y directions.

sourceParts.name: Shaft Coupler
sourceParts.description: This aluminum coupling connects the Z-axis stepper motor to the leadscrew to allow FarmBot to move in the Z direction.

sourceParts.name: V-Wheel
sourceParts.description: These polycarbonate V-wheels are precision machined to allow FarmBot to move in the X, Y, and Z directions smoothly and precisely. Each wheel comes pre-assembled with two stainless steel rubber-sealed ball bearings and one M5 precision shim.

sourceParts.name: X-Axis Cable Carrier
sourceParts.description: These hollow plastic chains are used throughout FarmBot to manage cables and tubing along each of the three axes.

sourceParts.name: Y-Axis Cable Carrier
sourceParts.description: These hollow plastic chains are used throughout FarmBot to manage cables and tubing along each of the three axes.

sourceParts.name: Z-Axis Cable Carrier
sourceParts.description: These hollow plastic chains are used throughout FarmBot to manage cables and tubing along each of the three axes.

sourceParts.name: Camera Cable
sourceParts.description: This cable connects the camera to the Raspberry Pi through the y-axis cable carrier.

sourceParts.name: Camera Calibration Card
sourceParts.description: Use this card to perform an automatic calibration of FarmBot's camera.

sourceParts.name: Camera
sourceParts.description: The camera is mounted on the z-axis and allows FarmBot to take photos of the garden and plants for weed detection and tracking plant growth.

sourceParts.name: Electronics Box
sourceParts.description: This rainproof box protects FarmBot's electronics from rain and debris. It features an easy-to-use tool-less double latch design for quickly opening and closing the box, a rubber gasket to keep moisture out, and a custom gland for all of FarmBot's cables to be passed through. The lid, latches, and box are made of UV stabilized materials.

sourceParts.name: Encoder Cable
sourceParts.description: These cables connect the four rotary encoders to the Farmduino. They are labelled on the Farmduino end X1, X2, Y, and ZY. The Z-axis cable is split into a Y-axis section labelled ZY and a Z-axis section labelled ZZ that connect with a 90-degree screw-together waterproof connection at the cross-slide.

sourceParts.name: Encoder
sourceParts.description: These rotary encoders provide closed-loop feedback of the motor positions in realtime, allowing FarmBot to perform automatic homing and calibration, and detect stalls. Download the [encoder spec sheet](https://drive.google.com/file/d/15dSqr_hQTXAQGIvw-YeDLIOC6dB0Y26n/view?usp=sharing).

sourceParts.name: Farmduino Data Cable
sourceParts.description: This USB cable is used as a serial connection between the Raspberry Pi and the Farmduino.

sourceParts.name: Farmduino
sourceParts.description: The Farmduino microcontroller features a board layout and connectors that are optimized for FarmBot. It receives G-code commands from the Raspberry Pi and then moves the motors, reads sensors, activate peripherals, and more. It features integrated Trinamic TMC2130 stepper drivers for ultra quiet movements and an STM32 coprocessor dedicated to monitoring the rotary encoders.

sourceParts.name: Fuse
sourceParts.description: This fuse is inserted into the Farmduino and protects the system from power surges.

sourceParts.name: Jumper Link
sourceParts.description: These connect the Grounded electronic pin to the Digital In pin, allowing FarmBot to detect when a tool has been mounted or dismounted correctly.

sourceParts.name: LED Strip
sourceParts.description: This LED strip is strung through the gantry's horizontal cable carrier supports so that you can light up your garden at night to show friends or for easy harvesting. Please note: this is not a grow light.

sourceParts.name: Micro SD Card Adapter
sourceParts.description: This adapter allows the microSD card to be plugged into a standard sized SD card slot.

sourceParts.name: Micro SD Card
sourceParts.description: The microSD card holds FarmBot OS and is inserted into the Raspberry Pi.

sourceParts.name: Motor Cable
sourceParts.description: These 4-wire cables connect each NEMA 17 stepper motor to the Farmduino. They are labelled on the Farmduino end X1, X2, Y, and ZY. The Z-axis cable is split into a Y-axis section labelled ZY and a Z-axis section labelled ZZ that connect with a 90-degree screw-together waterproof connection at the cross-slide.

sourceParts.name: Motor
sourceParts.description: These powerful 200 resolution stepper motors allow FarmBot to move precisely in the X, Y, and Z directions. Download the [motor spec sheet](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ehqu20q84Lyycn1fOj6dvWKbrMLvoNv4/view?usp=sharing) and [encoder spec sheet](https://drive.google.com/file/d/15dSqr_hQTXAQGIvw-YeDLIOC6dB0Y26n/view?usp=sharing).

sourceParts.name: Pi Adapter Board
sourceParts.description: This PCB mounts directly onto the Raspberry Pi's GPIO pin header and provides push buttons and LED indicators as well as connectors for external buttons and LEDs. It also features a real-time clock for timekeeping in offline situations.

sourceParts.name: Pogo Pin Jam Nut
sourceParts.description: 24 of these nuts are used to secure the pogo pins to the UTM PCB.

sourceParts.name: Pogo Pin
sourceParts.description: 12 of these pogo pins are used in the UTM to make electrical contact with FarmBot's tools.

sourceParts.name: Power Cord Protector
sourceParts.description: Tech specs for the power supply, power supply cable, and power cord protector in FarmBot Genesis. Visit [our shop](http://shop.farm.bot) to purchase parts.

sourceParts.name: Power Supply Cable
sourceParts.description: This modular 3-wire cable connects the power supply to the Farmduino. It features a waterproof 3-pin connector to attach to the power supply, and a black molex connector to attach to the Farmduino.

sourceParts.name: Power Supply
sourceParts.description: This universal input IP67 waterproof power supply provides FarmBot with all the electricity it needs.

sourceParts.name: Push Button Nut
sourceParts.description: These nuts secure the push buttons to the electronics box.

sourceParts.name: Push Button O-Ring
sourceParts.description: These O-rings make a seal between the LED indicators and the electronics box.

sourceParts.name: Red Push Button
sourceParts.description: This waterproof push button comes pre-mounted on the top of the electronics box and is reserved for the E-STOP functionality.

sourceParts.name: White Push Button
sourceParts.description: These waterproof push buttons come pre-mounted on the top of the electronics box and can be customized in the app.

sourceParts.name: Push Button Wiring Harness
sourceParts.description: These wiring harnesses connect the push buttons to the Pi adapter board.

sourceParts.name: Yellow Push Button
sourceParts.description: This waterproof push button comes pre-mounted on the top of the electronics box and is reserved for the UNLOCK functionality.

sourceParts.name: Raspberry Pi Power Cable
sourceParts.description: This USB cable provides power to the Raspberry Pi from the Farmduino's built-in 12v to 5v to USB circuitry.

sourceParts.name: Raspberry Pi
sourceParts.description: This is the host computer of FarmBot. You might also call it FarmBot's brain. The Raspberry Pi runs FarmBot OS, communicates with the web application over ethernet or WiFi, and talks to the Farmduino over a USB serial connection.

sourceParts.name: Rotary Tool Motor
sourceParts.description: The muscle of the rotary tool is this 24V DC motor.

sourceParts.name: Rotary Tool PCB
sourceParts.description: This circuit board provides EMI filtering for the rotary tool motor as well as provisions to prevent a system voltage drop when the motor powers on.

sourceParts.name: Realtime Clock Battery
sourceParts.description: This battery is inserted into the Pi Adapter Board to provide power for the realtime clock.

sourceParts.name: Shunt
sourceParts.description: These 2.54mm pitch 1x2 shunts are used to pre-jump the UTM cable to the Arduino MCU on the Farmduino electronics board.

sourceParts.name: Soil Sensor PCB
sourceParts.description: The Soil Moisture Sensor is a simple breakout for measuring the moisture in soil and similar materials. The soil moisture sensor is pretty straight forward to use. The two large exposed pads function as probes for the sensor, together acting as a variable resistor. The more water that is in the soil means the better the conductivity between the pads will be and will result in a lower resistance, and a higher SIG out.

sourceParts.name: Solenoid Valve Cable
sourceParts.description: This cable connects the solenoid valve to the Farmduino.

sourceParts.name: Solenoid Valve
sourceParts.description: This 24V valve controls the flow of water from your garden hose to FarmBot's tubing.

sourceParts.name: Supergland
sourceParts.description: Two of these silicon rubber glands provide a seal for the cables passed through the bottom of the electronics box.

sourceParts.name: Y UTM Cable
sourceParts.description: This 12-wire shielded cable connects the Farmduino to the UTM. It comes in two pieces, a Y-axis section and a Z-axis section that connect with a 90-degree screw-together waterproof connection at the cross-slide. It provides Ground, 5V, 24V, digital and analog I/O, with a pin mapping that can be configured at the Farmduino to support custom tools. It features connectors on both ends for easy connection to both the UTM and Farmduino, as well as a rubber shroud to protect the inside of the UTM from the elements.

sourceParts.name: Z UTM Cable
sourceParts.description: This 12-wire shielded cable connects the Farmduino to the UTM. It comes in two pieces, a Y-axis section and a Z-axis section that connect with a 90-degree screw-together waterproof connection at the cross-slide. It provides Ground, 5V, 24V, digital and analog I/O, with a pin mapping that can be configured at the Farmduino to support custom tools. It features connectors on both ends for easy connection to both the UTM and Farmduino, as well as a rubber shroud to protect the inside of the UTM from the elements.

sourceParts.name: UTM PCB
sourceParts.description: This PCB features 12 pre-mounted pogo pins to enable electrical connection with FarmBot's tools. [Click here to download the source files](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BTdp27t__LOzHmLJjJt_slEUzAGGNGCx).

sourceParts.name: Y Vacuum Pump Cable
sourceParts.description: This cable connects the vacuum pump to the Farmduino.

sourceParts.name: Vacuum Pump
sourceParts.description: This 24V vacuum pump sucks air through the seeder's luer lock needle in order to suction-hold a seed on the needle tip during planting. It features a PCB direct-soldered onto the back of the motor to provide EMI filtering and smooth startup current draw.

sourceParts.name: Gantry Column
sourceParts.description: The gantry columns are made from aluminum extrusions. They can be scaled to be taller or shorter to satisfy your needs. The large space inside the columns is used to conceal and protect the GT2 timing belts that run along the tracks and up to the X-axis motors.

sourceParts.name: Gantry Main Beam
sourceParts.description: This aluminum extrusion serves as the gantry's primary structural element. The cross-slide's v-wheels move across this extrusion, allowing FarmBot to move in the y-direction. It is possible to make this extrusion longer or shorter to suit your needs.

sourceParts.name: Track Extrusion
sourceParts.description: The track extrusions are directly mounted to the top outer edges of the supporting infrastrucutre. They are combined end-to-end in order to create longer tracks. The gantry V-wheels roll along the track extrusions, allowing FarmBot to move in the x-direction.

sourceParts.name: Z-Axis Extrusion
sourceParts.description: This aluminum extrusion allows FarmBot to accurately position the UTM and tools in the z-direction. It slides through the vertically aligned wheels on the front of the cross-slide.

sourceParts.name: Vertical Motor Housing

sourceParts.name: Rotary Tool Bottom

sourceParts.name: Rotary Tool Top

sourceParts.name: Seed Bin
sourceParts.description: This plastic bin allows you to load many seeds of the same type into your FarmBot.

sourceParts.name: Seed Tray

sourceParts.description: This gantry-mounted seed trough holder allows FarmBot to bring seeds with it while traveling along the x-axis, shortening the time needed for seed injection.

sourceParts.name: Seed Trough

sourceParts.name: Seeder
